description: This file defines the TraceMiddleware class in the AWS SDK for PHP. It is responsible for tracing and logging the state changes and HTTP request/response details between AWS SDK middleware layers. It includes methods for capturing request and response data, sanitizing sensitive information, and invoking a configurable logging function.

classes.name: TraceMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for tracing the input and output of AWS SDK commands, including request/response data and errors, with configurable logging and data scrubbing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes TraceMiddleware with configuration options and an optional Service object for accessing shapes.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Returns a handler function that logs detailed trace information for each command, including timing, request, and response data.

methods.name: stepInput
methods.description: Logs the input (request/command) before the next middleware executes.

methods.name: stepOutput
methods.description: Logs the output (response/error) after the middleware execution and the total step duration.

methods.name: compareStep
methods.description: Compares previous and current step data to identify changes and logs them.

methods.name: commandArray
methods.description: Creates a sanitized array representation of a command object.

methods.name: requestArray
methods.description: Creates a sanitized array representation of an HTTP request.

methods.name: responseArray
methods.description: Creates a sanitized array representation of an HTTP response.

methods.name: resultArray
methods.description: Converts a result object into an array format for logging.

methods.name: exceptionArray
methods.description: Serializes an exception, especially AwsException, with details for logging.

methods.name: compareArray
methods.description: Recursively compares two arrays or values to identify differences for logging.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Converts a value into a string representation, including dumping objects or exceptions.

methods.name: streamStr
methods.description: Returns the string content of a stream if its size is below the threshold; otherwise, indicates stream size.

methods.name: createHttpDebug
methods.description: Adds a debug resource to the command for capturing HTTP debug information if enabled.

methods.name: flushHttpDebug
methods.description: Outputs and clears the stored HTTP debug information from the command.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Logs a message, optionally scrubbed of sensitive data, using the configured log function.

methods.name: redactHeaders
methods.description: Sanitizes headers by replacing sensitive headers with scrubbed values.

methods.name: getRedactedArray
methods.description: Recursively redacts sensitive parameters in a command array based on service shape definitions.
